significance: A Ganesha temple in Kumbakonam whose 1692 inscription records grants made under the Thanjavur Maratha rulers at the time of a renovation. It also holds a Navagraha Vinayaga, and at Vinayaka Chaturthi the deity is decorated with currency notes.
story: The site is said to have revealed itself when the ashes of the sage Bhagavar Maharishi's mother turned into flowers as they were immersed in the Kaveri here.
